title: The Legend of the Strongest, Kurosawa!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kurosawa, an unpopular 44-year-old construction site foreman, realizes on a birthday no one remembers that he has lived without drive or purpose. His clumsy attempts to win respect and popularity backfire, and he ends up in fights with delinquent middle schoolers. The series by Nobuyuki Fukumoto mixes comedy with reflections on loneliness and dignity; database tags mention homelessness.
life_message: A life gains meaning when an ordinary person finds the courage to stand up and be seen, even late and clumsily.
